$comment: Teams of this repository. Format: a JSON object whose 'teams' array holds one entry per team with 'id' (lowercase letters, digits and hyphens), 'name', 'lead' (an id from penguin/owners.json: the person who leads the team) and 'members' (ids from penguin/owners.json). Each scope in penguin/scopes.json names its team, its DRI and its fallback order from the team's members.
